title: [Salty's Services, Roofs]
description: Sample building materials are piled high along the walls and are stacked high in the corner as the way through the warehouse turns at a sharp angle.  Long planks of driftwood, oak, bamboo, and several other woods are set in clear view of this main path.  Above, the warehouse is noticeably damaged, and a conspicuous fabric-covered hole stretches broadly across a wide section of ceiling, with a muted light filtering down through it.
